شججت (form I)
# شَجَجْتُ (šajajtu) /ʃa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of شَجَّ (šajja)
# شَجَجْتَ (šajajta) /ʃa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of شَجَّ (šajja)
# شَجَجْتِ (šajajti) /ʃa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of شَجَّ (šajja)
# شُجِجْتُ (šujijtu) /ʃu.d͡ʒid͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of شَجَّ (šajja)
# شُجِجْ
